segments.text: The Atomic Habits promise: get one percent better every day, and you're thirty-seven times better in a year.
Here's the honest part. That thirty-seven isn't a law of nature.
It's just one point oh one, times itself, three hundred sixty-five times. A calculator, not a guarantee.
But the idea underneath is the useful part. There's no such thing as a neutral day.
Every choice pushes you up, or down. Never flat.
You won't be thirty-seven times better. But the tiny thing you do today isn't nothing. It's the direction you're pointed.
That's the honest version. The full verdict's on the channel.
